partner-payment-count.query: select count(p.id) from payments p where p.booking_id in(select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid)

partner-revenue.query: select coalesce(sum(p.amount),0) from payments p where p.status='success' and p.booking_id in(select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid)

partner-booking-counts.query: select count(b.id),sum(case when b.status='pending' then 1 else 0 end),sum(case when b.status='cancelled' then 1 else 0 end),sum(case when b.status='completed' then 1 else 0 end) from bookings b where b.id in(select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid)
